payload.title: Record production deployment provenance and verify the live release
payload.description:
## Purpose

Make each production deployment auditable and independently verifiable instead of inferring its source branch from a local checkout.

## Verified gap

The current CDK/CloudFormation stack records successful manual updates but not the Git branch or commit SHA that produced them.

## Acceptance

- The deployment workflow records the exact `main` SHA, branch, release version when present, and GitHub Actions run URL in durable deploy evidence.
- After CDK completes, it verifies the `Sierrendipity` CloudFormation stack reaches `UPDATE_COMPLETE` and checks the live site/config endpoint.
- The record identifies whether a deployment was manual or GitHub Actions-driven.
- A maintainer can answer which revision is live from retained evidence without consulting a developer workstation.

## Guardrail

Do not expose OAuth, session, or AWS credentials in workflow logs or provenance.
